prior_year_events.impact_description: Prior year strengthening in respect of losses arising from Covid 19 led to an adverse impact on prior year reserves, particularly affecting the Global Re (assumed reinsurance) portfolio.

named_events.loss_description: The estimate for net losses arising from the Russia/Ukraine war is currently held at GBP 18.7m of IBNR.
Prior year strengthening in respect of losses arising from Covid 19 contributed to an underwriting loss in the Global Re division.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the syndicate's opening (2021) gross claims outstanding were GBP 740.162m. During 2022 gross prior-underwriting-year provisions increased by GBP 194.595m (a 26.3% adverse movement versus opening gross reserves), reflecting prior-year strengthening. The drivers called out in the report include prior-year losses arising from Covid-19 (notably affecting the Global Re/assumed reinsurance portfolio), reserves held for the Russia/Ukraine war and additional IBNR uplift for excess inflation. The movement is an overall strengthening (adverse) of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss reserves held in respect of the Russia/Ukraine war
prior year strengthening in respect of losses arising from Covid 19
In our IBNR we are currently holding GBP 15.4m relating to excess inflation, in response to current market conditions.
The estimate for net losses arising from the Russia/Ukraine war is currently held at GBP 18.7m of IBNR.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross GBP 194.595m) is taken directly from the 'Change in prior underwriting year's provisions' line in the Technical Provisions reconciliation table (gross column). Exact reserve-descriptive sentences in the narrative are limited; the report provides the numeric movement in a table row. Some class-level prior-year surplus/(deficit) figures are reported for combined labels (e.g. 'Marine, aviation and transport') and were mapped to the closest standard LOB where possible (mapping of combined categories is approximate). 'Reinsurance acceptances' is represented as 'Treaty' in LOB mappings. All monetary amounts converted to millions. Net figures mentioned in narrative (e.g. net IBNR for Russia/Ukraine) were not used for gross PYD since a gross amount was available.
